header.description: Two-ship Yak-3 + La-7 envelope-interpolation scenario -- the first golden flying the two roster airframes that gained generated envelope-table entries after v1.19r0 (previously no golden exercised their LUTs in C++ <-> Python lockstep). The ships are near-antipodal (lon 0 vs lon 180, ~47 km apart on the 94 km-circumference sphere) so they can never interact; each flies a profile chosen to traverse its OWN phi_max/roll_rate LUT interpolation segments and its B1/B3 aero scalars, then fires a closing burst so per-airframe weapon scalars (muzzle_v 800, rof 7 vs 6, convergence 180 vs 200, damage 28 vs 30, ammo 140 vs 170) are pinned as LIVE rounds in the sealed final snapshot. AC0 (Yak-3, equator, psi 90, 3500 m, TAS 150 -- strictly inside the [120,160] LUT segment): phase 0 commands bank 70 deg (over-limit -> the interpolated phi_max clamp binds at ~48 deg and the roll_rate(V) slew takes ~0.5 s) at g 1.45 / full throttle -- an accelerating banked turn that crosses the 160 m/s LUT breakpoint upward (segment switch); phase 1 (t=1500) reverses to bank -20 at throttle 0.3 -- the ~68 deg reversal exercises the roll_rate slew in the [160,185] segment while TAS decays back through the 160 breakpoint downward; phase 2 (t=2500) levels the wings; phase 3 (t=2800) opens fire to the end -- ~29 rounds at rof 7, all inside the 250-tick TTL at tick 3000. AC1 (La-7, lat 10 / lon 180, psi 270, 3000 m, TAS 110 -- strictly inside the [85,125] segment): phase 0 commands bank -60 (clamps at the interpolated ~-52 to -49 deg as the clamp tightens with speed) at the near-level-turn g 1.62 / full throttle, crossing the 125 m/s breakpoint upward (~131 m/s by t=1800); phase 1 (t=1800) is a 1 s g 8.0 pull at bank 30 -- n_aero stays in [8.20, 9.27] through the pull, so the STRUCTURAL limit (n_max_struct 8) is the binding B3 clamp throughout while induced drag + the climbing flight path bleed ~8 m/s; phase 2 (t=1900) recovers at g 0.8 / throttle 0.5 while TAS falls back DOWN through both the 125 and the 85 breakpoints (ending ~83 m/s -- three LUT segments visited); phase 3 (t=2800) levels and fires to the end -- ~34 rounds at rof 6. No round can connect (owner-excluded, nearest foreign target ~40 km): hp/regions stay full, kills 0, last_hit_by -1 -- this golden pins TRAJECTORY + weapon-scalar determinism, not combat (Hit/Winchester/EngineOut own those). Exercises: piecewise-linear LUT interpolation at non-breakpoint TAS for both new envtab entries, LUT segment switches in both directions, the phi_max clamp + roll_rate slew, both B3 load-factor clamps, B1 thrust/drag integration with both aero parameter sets, and the G3/G4/v1.15r0 weapon scalar set live in the snapshot bytes.
